objective: Register the existing MacJev repository with the current AppSDK governance contract and Collab coordination while preserving all model, download, runtime evidence, and existing experiment state.

boundary.payload_control_separation: confirmed: AppSDK and Collab control state never enters Jev request, response, model, or backend payloads

acceptance_criteria: appsdk init completes without replacing existing project files
collab context reports a live registered peer for the MacJev project
the user-authorized peer is promoted to the MacJev Collab master when no live master exists
existing model files, download state, M2 evidence, and PLAN.md remain unchanged
non_goals: Do not reset or migrate any prior AppSDK or Collab control plane
Do not modify model weights, download configuration, runtime evidence, or M2 experiment files
Do not put governance state into the Jev protocol or DiffGemma backend payload
assumptions: MacJev has no prior AppSDK project contract or Collab project identity
The user's explicit request to register Collab master authorizes this project governance initialization and role promotion
confirmed_by: Jason (explicit request to register Collab master and upgrade AppSDK)
